title: Nearest Repeated Word Distance
statement:
Find how close together the nearest repeated word appears in a sequence.

Contract
- `words` is non-null, may be empty, and contains non-null strings.
- Return the minimum difference between indices `i` and `j` with `i < j` and `words[i].equals(words[j])`.
- Return `-1` when no word appears at least twice.
- Matching is exact and case-sensitive. Do not mutate the input array.

Examples
- `[all, work, and, no, play, makes, for, no, fun]` returns 4 for the two `no` entries.
- `[a, b, c]` returns -1.
- `[x, y, x, x]` returns 1 for the adjacent `x` entries at the end.

examples.input: [all, work, and, no, play, makes, for, no, fun]

hints: Record the most recent index where each word was seen.
When a word appears again, compare the current index with the previous one and update the best distance.
Only the latest index for each word can produce the shortest future distance. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space.
inputSyntax: Input: a bracketed word list, for example: [all, work, and, no, play, makes, for, no, fun]
sampleInput: [all, work, and, no, play, makes, for, no, fun]
